data.name: Butylbenzene with Water
measurement_methods: In a thermostatted glass-stoppered flask 10-25 mL (1) was shaken for min 4 hrs. with titrated water (a few mL of HTO equivalent to ca. 2 mc/mL), decanted, a 5-mL aliquot reshaken for 4 hrs. with 5 mL H_2O in a 10 mL flask, sampled and assayed with a Nuclear Enterprises type 8301 liquid scintillation counter. The two-stage process eliminates quenching effect (due to solvent) on the scintillator.
